svg.title: The Holy Earth Foundation. Plants & Miracles.
svg.desc: The foundation's mark, a golden heart within a circle of light, at the heart of a breathing Golden Halo whose rays slowly turn, in a forest before dawn. The Vine of the Soul, a twin-stranded liana of sky and gold with paired leaves, tendrils and small pink-white blossoms, grows around the frame and then breathes; fireflies drift. I am one Self, united with my Creator.
